Actual final conversions retain the same embedded target ICC bytes, relative-intent/BPC-off, white alpha remove/off, metadata strip, sampling 4:2:0 and interlace flags. Every attempted candidate starts empty at a distinct owned path; superseded candidates and empty directories are removed.

A successful known warning is finalized as ConvertedWithWarning and NativeWarnings is a subset of finalized converted images. Duplicate links retain that warning status. Failed/nonfinalized candidates do not contribute warning counters.

The COM-padded above-cap JPEG is a genuine decodable controlled encoder length oracle for state transitions, not a real resizing or privacy-stripping claim for the controlled call. Actual final calls perform the production transformation.
source_preservation_observations: Integration cases compare all synthetic source SHA256, lengths, creation and modified ticks before/after, retained parent sentinel bytes/times, mirrored opaque video hashes and modified times, exact final media lists and empty owned work.
Opaque synthetic MP4 bytes prove unchanged copying, not playable video encoding or decoding.
limitations: Permission/resource-exhaustion application outcomes use controlled real child diagnostics without changing ACLs or exerting machine memory/disk pressure. Genuine exclusive-file-lock Permission denied and damaged/unknown-coder probes establish available actual native classifications separately.

The runtime quiet flag suppresses the observed harmless JPEG notice, so application acceptance re-emits the exact qualified reason in an owned native child after real production conversion. No arbitrary warning is accepted.

The fixture process uses a 15-second test watchdog solely to prevent a hung test; these observations do not claim production per-file timeout/cancellation lifecycle coverage, which belongs to later tasks.
The one-byte sizing stress result has full decode/dimension checks without an invented high-quality floor; established Colour/Sizing tests retain their independent alpha/reference checks.

history_interpretation:
The initial Diagnostics target passed 10/23 and failed 13 because the owned managed fixture could not handle generated long paths and the pixel oracle used invalid FX syntax. Some rejection assertions could pass for the unintended fixture crash, so later tests require the intended native exit, complete streams and actual candidate. Corrected intermediate targets passed 26/26 in both shells; final targets passed 27/27 with the actual eight-call boundary. Separately, both first focused runs passed 131/132: the invalid-curve native work was safely rejected but the new category assertion expected DamagedInput. A narrow classifier reason correction produced 132/132 reruns. Runtime edits overlapped those first focused runs, so their end hashes do not prove immutable import bytes.

The first clean committed implementation failed each desktop normal 268/269 and control 268/270 (T005 plus deliberate T007), and all four hosted normals failed 268/269 with control steps skipped. T005 still expected an unexplained exit 9 to retry. A three-line test-only correction supplied an explicit transient reason; both focused Normalizer reruns passed 6/6. Runtime bytes were unchanged. The original commit, raw source snapshots, summaries/XML/native records, hosted logs and independent diagnosis are retained. Final acceptance uses a separate clean corrected revision. Tooling-only inspection mistakes contribute no application or Pester acceptance counts.

The second clean committed implementation passed all four desktop gates and both hosted matrices (269/269 normal; 270 total, 269 passed and exact T007 control). A separate actual native result-shape probe then found that the unchanged development measurement trace recorded absent DiagnosticOutput as null, bypassing its strict diagnostic guard. Its narrow adapter now records bounded separate streams with legacy fallback and returns the original result unchanged. Actual saved-AST checks passed five cases per host, with full JPEG decode and genuine warning/quiet cases. Those probes observed I2 HEAD plus the edited tool, whose raw bytes match final I3; they are not relabeled as clean-I3 runs or a representative benchmark. I2 successful gates, all 26 raw source snapshots, original CI/merge/review and both omission/correction proofs remain preserved. Final task acceptance uses fresh full/hosted gates at I3.

internal_peer_review.scope: Exact committed implementation; internal peer code review, not owner acceptance.

findings.details: Two C# reader threads use fixed4096-char blocks and bounded prefix/tail rings. Per-item retained bound16384 chars per stream; preflight262144. Full counters/truncation and stream-completion data separate from exit. Any truncation/incomplete capture rejects, so eviction cannot convert earlier error into accepted warning.

C# uses Framework-compatible APIs and Windows CRT quote/backslash handling. UseShellExecute=false and CreateNoWindow=true. Existing registry literal guards and selected-input/frame/ICC operands remain in order; no mandatory runtime dependency or global settings change.

Version/formats, source counts/colour, ICC extraction and full JPEG decode use bounded wrapper with strict zero-exit/empty-stderr policy. Genuine ICC version99 native0 error remains unacceptable; native exit independent of PS stderr preferences.

Only anchored lossless-to-lossy reason + warning/jpeg.c/WriteJPEGImage_ location allows exit0; both actual backtick and apostrophe opening accepted. Full candidate validation remains mandatory. Nonzero/unknown/mixed errors fail. NativeWarnings and SizeWarnings are distinct attributes incremented after successful move; warned retained duplicate status preserved.

Permanent and unknown failures stop current item immediately. Explicit anchored sharing/lock reason with empty stdout or trusted Win3232/33 alone can retry2 times per file with100/200ms delay, same scale/full flags and fresh exact-owned candidate. Signed IOException facility mask rejects another facility with lowword32. Six scales advance only after valid above-cap outcomes; actual test executes max8 total calls and no stale candidate resurrection.

Bounded native details log quietly; console gets compact outcomes/retry reasons. Before a run log exists, setup has bounded512-char native-detail console fallback without premature output allocation. Existing preflight initial15000ms deadline and owned PID/taskkill-tree fallback remain; conversion deadline/cancellation not introduced.

Default runner adds Diagnostics; Colour/Transactions expectations narrowly change to permanent first-failure stop or diagnosed transient retry. Genuine no-regard/regarded warning, missing coder/truncated JPEG/exclusive lock establish provenance; unsafe-category and sharing notices are controlled. New child executable/config/compiler are owned ignored fixtures; AppContext long-path switches apply only to fixture executable. Source/video bytes/timestamps, white ICC policy, final no-overwrite and exact owned cleanup asserted.

Exactly9 implementation/test/doc paths. primary_references.finding: Separate readers for stdout and stderr avoid full-pipe dependency; read before exit-wait; two reader threads are documented.

Win32 32 is sharing violation; 33 is byte-range lock violation. Permission denied alone is not proof of either.
Warning severity range 300..399, error 400..499, fatal 700..799. CLI text exposes warning/error/fatal location but not numeric enum.
ThrowMagickExceptionList formats reason plus @ warning/error/fatal/module/function/line. Reason can be locale-dependent; unknown text fails closed.

implementation_notes: Stdout and stderr now drain on separate C# reader threads through fixed character buffers. The structured result keeps exit, streams, total decoded character counts, truncation and read/start/timeout failures separate. Ordinary item capture retains at most 16,384 UTF-16 characters per stream; preflight queries now capture at most 262,144 UTF-16 characters per stream and retain their existing 15-second deadline. Overflow or incomplete capture rejects the item.

Every nonzero native exit rejects conversion. Exit 0 also rejects error, fatal, ICC, corruption, resource or unknown diagnostics. Only the pinned JPEG writer's exact whole-line lossless-to-lossy warning may accompany exit 0, complete capture and a fully validated JPEG; source/ICC inspection and full candidate decode remain strict. Production quiet and regard-warnings flags remain enabled.

Only trusted Win32 sharing/lock codes 32 or 33, or an exact specific sharing/lock native reason, permit retry. Each image has at most two retries total, after 100 and 200 milliseconds, at the same scale with identical colour/alpha/JPEG flags and a new exclusive owned candidate. Generic denial, missing codecs, damaged input, resource exhaustion and unknown failures stop immediately.

The six 100, 90, 80, 70, 60 and 50 percent scales remain size-search steps reached only after a valid above-cap candidate. Two transient retries can add at most two conversions across the whole image, so six scales plus retries are bounded to eight calls. Failed native work or candidate validation never reuses an earlier candidate.

Attempt, category, native exit and bounded details are logged; console output keeps concise item and retry reasons, including a bounded setup diagnostic before a run log exists. A successfully finalized accepted native warning has ConvertedWithWarning status, adds one NativeWarnings count within ConvertedImages, and returns the existing application warning code 2. SizeWarnings stays a separate attribute; failed finalization and duplicate skips do not add retained warnings.

The public PS1/BAT forms, exact default 1,048,576-byte cap, scales, orientation/ICC/sRGB/white-alpha/strip order, sampling and progressive JPEG settings retain their prior policy. Stable source snapshots, literal paths, no-overwrite finalization, successful duplicate links, source bytes/times and byte-identical video copying remain the regression boundary. No encoder tuning, benchmark rerun or new runtime dependency is introduced.

The existing development measurement trace now records bounded stdout/stderr from the structured result, with legacy DiagnosticOutput fallback for its frozen baseline. It returns the original result unchanged. Actual saved-AST checks in both hosts verify warning/quiet/stdout guard behavior; these are consumer compatibility probes, not a repeat of the representative benchmark or an encoder change.
limitations: Fixed diagnostic retention bounds decoded text and rejects truncation; it is not a general CPU, disk, native lifetime or descendant-pipe sandbox. General per-file deadlines, cancellation and owned descendant lifecycle remain later M3 work. The existing preflight deadline is 15 seconds.

The harmless-warning allowance is one pinned English JPEG reason and location, not a broad warning exemption. Genuine visible warning provenance omitted regard-warnings; the corresponding visible warning with regard-warnings is nonzero and must reject. Controlled application warning acceptance is identified separately. Unknown or localized diagnostics fail conservatively.

The retry tests and trusted codes establish a narrow bound, not reliable recovery from every sharing condition. ImageMagick mapped an actual owned exclusive lock to generic Permission denied, which remains nonretryable. Resource tests use process-local synthetic cache limits rather than exhausting the machine.

NativeWarnings and SizeWarnings describe successfully retained converted files; application warning code 2 does not establish final BAT exit propagation or successful log persistence. Those reporting and launcher contracts remain later work.
